decisions.reason: After only one year and with no negative signals, uncertainty about its value remains high while keeping costs are modest, so the option should remain open.
The product is still in an early stage with unresolved market uncertainty, and the firm can afford to hold this option alongside related automation projects.
Although it is less central than the shuttering robots, its prospects are still uncertain and the cost of keeping the option open is low relative to the potential value.
There is insufficient evidence to conclude the value will not be realized, so real options reasoning favors keeping this related robot on the market for now.
